craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of practiced freedom — fire-and-freedom song, practice to vision. Always-walks; freed-full; always kept double. Rejected: (a) trimming always → killed: always is the practice. Read aloud: BY-true re-FLEC-tion's-POW-er … BE-comes.

lines: By true reflection's power, always, who walks —
freed from every bond, full of endless bliss, becomes.
l4.sanskrit_cite: sadvimarśabalenaivaṃ nityaṃ yaḥ pariśīlate | sa muktaḥ sarvabandhebhyo nityānandamayo bhavet

reads_against.argmap: Who is freed by reflection? → Always-practice frees fully.
c1_essence: Awake fire swallows; all-devouring to be known.
Grown fire shines knowing-made; nectar outside.
Constant knower freed frees scores flash-fast.
reads_against.c1_rasa: vīra of practiced freedom; raudra of devouring fire; vīra of soon attainment; adbhuta of shining universe; līlā-śānta of still play; karuṇa-vīra of freeing; śānta of standing; vīra of desired-in-distraction; adbhuta of shown vision; adbhuta of bodiless expansion
